stories.title: Bitcoin ETF Inflow Streak Ends at $3 Billion, but ETH, XRP, and Solana ETFs Keep Buying
stories.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs stopped their inflow streak after pulling in about $3 billion over recent days. Meanwhile, ETFs tied to Ethereum, XRP, and Solana kept seeing net buying, according to CryptoSlate.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows are a key gauge of institutional demand, and a split between Bitcoin and altcoin ETFs signals where that demand is shifting.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitcoin ETF flows turn negative in coming days
Whether altcoin ETF inflows continue at the same pace
questions: What caused the pause in Bitcoin ETF buying?
Are the altcoin ETF inflows a lasting trend or a short-term rotation?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows snap after $3 billion streak as ETH, XRP and Solana keep buying

stories.title: Bitcoin Miner IREN Still Gets 82% of Revenue From BTC After Clearing Room for Microsoft AI Cloud Deal
stories.summary: Bitcoin miner IREN still draws 82% of its revenue from Bitcoin mining, even after freeing up capacity for a Microsoft AI cloud deal, CryptoSlate reports. The figure suggests the AI pivot has not yet reshaped the company's revenue mix.
stories.whyItMatters: Miners diversifying into AI compute face a tension between mining economics and cloud contracts, and investors want to know which business actually drives revenue.
whatToWatch: How IREN's revenue split changes as the Microsoft deal ramps up
questions: How large is the Microsoft AI cloud contract compared with IREN's mining revenue?
Will the revenue mix shift meaningfully in coming quarters?

stories.title: SEC Reviews Automatic Filing Pathways After Flood of Exotic Crypto and Event-Linked ETF Proposals
stories.summary: The SEC is reviewing automatic filing pathways for ETFs after a wave of exotic crypto and event-linked ETF proposals flooded the market, CryptoSlate reports. The review suggests regulators are weighing whether the fast-track process needs tighter rules.
stories.whyItMatters: How the SEC treats ETF filing pathways will shape how quickly new crypto ETF products, including niche and event-linked ones, reach investors.
whatToWatch: Any SEC rule change or guidance on ETF filing pathways
Whether the review slows approvals of new crypto ETF proposals
questions: Which specific proposals prompted this review?
Will the SEC tighten the automatic filing process or just clarify it?

stories.title: Polygon Discloses Security Flaws Already Fixed in Recent Hard Forks
stories.summary: Polygon disclosed security flaws that its recent hard forks had already fixed, Cointelegraph reports. Disclosing after the fact is common practice, so patches ship before attackers learn of the weakness.
stories.whyItMatters: Retroactive vulnerability disclosures let users and developers judge how exposed the network was and how the team handles security response.
whatToWatch: Further details on the severity of the disclosed flaws
Whether any funds or transactions were affected before the fixes
questions: Were any funds at risk before the hard forks patched the flaws?
How long was the vulnerability window open?

sources.title: Polygon discloses security flaws fixed in recent hard forks

stories.title: Stellar's Tokenized Real-World Asset Market Quadruples to Nearly $4 Billion
stories.summary: The value of tokenized real-world assets on Stellar has more than quadrupled to nearly $4 billion, Cointelegraph reports. It marks one of the sharpest growth stretches yet for real-world-asset tokenization on the network.
stories.whyItMatters: Tokenized real-world assets bridge traditional finance and crypto rails, and fast growth on one chain shows where institutional tokenization activity is concentrating.
whatToWatch: Which asset types are driving the growth
Whether the pace of growth continues or levels off
questions: What is driving the jump: new issuers, repricing, or reporting changes?
How does Stellar's growth compare with real-world-asset tokenization on other chains?

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs' 9-Day Inflow Streak Ends as BTC Dips Below $78,000
stories.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs saw their nine-day inflow streak end as Bitcoin's price dipped below $78,000, Cointelegraph reports. The pullback breaks a run of steady buying that had supported the price in prior weeks.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows are one of the clearest signals of institutional demand, so a reversal alongside a price drop raises questions about near-term conviction.
whatToWatch: Whether ETF flows turn net negative in coming days
Whether BTC holds above or falls further below $78,000
questions: Is this a pause or the start of a sustained outflow trend?
What triggered the price dip below $78,000?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETFs end 9-day inflow streak as BTC dips below $78K

stories.title: Bitcoin Faces New Macro Test as Fed Chair Kevin Warsh Flags Sticky Inflation
stories.summary: Bitcoin faces a fresh macro headwind after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh highlighted sticky inflation metrics, CryptoSlate reports. Persistent inflation readings complicate the outlook for the rate cuts that crypto markets had been counting on.
stories.whyItMatters: Fed policy signals move risk assets broadly, and Bitcoin has traded closely with rate-cut expectations in recent cycles.
whatToWatch: Upcoming Fed commentary or meetings on rate policy
Bitcoin's price reaction in the days ahead
questions: Which inflation metrics did Warsh cite?
How much does this shift the market's rate-cut expectations?

stories.title: Tokenized Stock Transfer Volume Jumps 415% in 30 Days to $29.5 Billion
stories.summary: Transfer volume for tokenized stocks jumped 415% over 30 days to reach $29.5 billion, Cointelegraph reports. The surge points to fast-growing activity in on-chain equity products.
stories.whyItMatters: Tokenized equities are an emerging bridge between stock markets and blockchain rails, and a jump this large signals accelerating adoption or speculation.
whatToWatch: Whether the volume growth holds or was a short-term spike
Which platforms or tokens are driving the increase
questions: Is the growth driven by new products, more users, or a few large transfers?
How does this compare with volume in the underlying stocks?

stories.title: Bitcoin Knots Attempts Another Fork After Its Last Chain Died Within Two Blocks
stories.summary: Bitcoin Knots is attempting to fork Bitcoin again, CryptoSlate reports, after its previous attempt collapsed just two blocks in. The repeat attempt suggests backers remain determined despite the earlier failure.
stories.whyItMatters: Fork attempts test how much support alternative Bitcoin implementations can gather, and a chain dying almost immediately shows how thin that support has been so far.
whatToWatch: Whether the new fork attracts more miners and nodes than the last attempt
How long the new chain survives
questions: What changed in this attempt versus the failed one?
Who is backing Bitcoin Knots, and why?

stories.title: Bitcoin Miners Morph Into High-Performance Computing Hubs, Leaving Pure Crypto Exposure Behind
stories.summary: Bitcoin miners are increasingly moving away from being pure Bitcoin-price proxies and turning into high-performance computing hubs, CryptoSlate reports. The shift reflects miners chasing AI and data-center demand alongside their mining business.
stories.whyItMatters: Investors who buy miner stocks as a Bitcoin proxy need to know their exposure is shifting toward AI infrastructure economics, not just crypto price.
whatToWatch: How individual miners' revenue mix evolves
New AI or data-center deals from major mining companies
questions: Which miners are furthest along in this pivot?
Does this diversification reduce or add risk for shareholders?

stories.title: Deribit Moved 90% of Client Assets to Coinbase, Then Dropped Its Daily Proof-of-Reserves Check
stories.summary: Derivatives exchange Deribit moved 90% of client assets into Coinbase custody and then discontinued its daily proof-of-reserves check, CryptoSlate reports. Dropping the check removes a transparency tool users had relied on to verify the exchange's holdings.
stories.whyItMatters: Proof-of-reserves checks became a standard trust signal after past exchange collapses, so ending one raises transparency questions even with custody at a regulated venue.
whatToWatch: Whether Deribit reinstates proof-of-reserves reporting or offers an alternative
User and regulator reaction to the change
questions: Why did Deribit end the daily check instead of continuing it under the new custody arrangement?
Does Coinbase provide its own attestations for the custodied assets?

stories.whyItMatters: Coinbase's push into products like US500 is a bellwether for how much real appetite exists for equity-linked crypto instruments.
whatToWatch: Follow-up trading volume for US500
Any Coinbase commentary on the product's trajectory
questions: What specifically caused the reality check?
Is this a one-off pullback or a sign of weak sustained demand?
